conceptZh: 科學家老鼠的蝴蝶網有自己的想法，亂甩亂飛，直到他輕輕一舉才網住蝶字的筆畫。
object: a bespectacled lab mouse with a mischievous butterfly net
morph: a net with its own opinion flings glittery pieces around until the mouse outsmarts it into 蝶
creativeAngle: 道具反抗：網子一直把筆畫甩開，老鼠改用輕輕一勾才成功。
promptEn: An 8-second animated clip on a pale lavender-pink background, with one single Traditional Chinese glyph 蝶 as the only text on screen, drawn in violet purple solid strokes, centered, uncropped, about 70% of frame height with generous margins. 0-1.7s: a bespectacled lab mouse in a tiny white coat swings a long-handled net that bends the wrong way and flings him in a circle; the first 蝶 is spoken as the left 虫 strokes flutter in like glittery wing-dust. 1.7-3.4s: the net slaps a bubbling beaker so it fizzes over and tosses the right-hand 枼 pieces across the frame; the second 蝶 is spoken as the mouse lowers the net gently, stops fighting it, and the pieces drift in one by one. 3.4-5s: 蝴蝶 is spoken as a shimmering lilac toy butterfly flaps out of the net, circles his head, and lands on his glasses, making him cross his eyes. 5-8s: hold; the butterfly opens and closes its wings on the mouse's nose, glyph still. Audio: a warm off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "蝶、蝶、蝴蝶" (ㄉㄧㄝˊ、ㄉㄧㄝˊ、ㄏㄨˊ ㄉㄧㄝˊ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, a short pause between the two single utterances, and stops after the word; no other speech, no subtitles, no vocabulary text. Final 3 seconds (5-8s): the glyph 蝶 is perfectly still and fully readable while the lead keeps a small joyful motion away from the strokes. Bright but not neon palette, no watermark, no flashing, no other writing.

conceptZh: 玩具機器人踮著腳、每一步都吱吱叫地偷偷去抓停在花盆上的蝴蝶，看守的賽車突然醒來，兩個面對面大叫一聲撞在一起，花盆的木莖葉子倒成右邊的枼，機器人震掉的螺絲和彈簧排成左邊的虫，蝶字就成形了。
object: a shimmering lilac toy butterfly perched on a small potted plant with a straight wooden stem and three flat leaves, guarded by a dozing googly-eyed pull-back race car
morph: the sneak-and-surprise collision knocks the pot over so the stem and leaves topple into the right-hand 枼, while the bolts and a springy coil shaken off the robot roll and curl into the left-hand 虫; the finished glyph 蝶 holds still while the butterfly lands on the robot's head
creativeAngle: 前一版是老鼠拿蝴蝶網的安靜追捕，這版改成完整的「偷偷摸摸被嚇到」橋段：機器人馬達太強、想輕卻踩得吱吱響，守衛賽車醒來後兩個面對面尖叫、對撞，撞擊本身把花盆和零件震成筆畫，不是物件自己飄過來。蝴蝶在說出「蝴蝶」的那一刻飛出來停在機器人頭上，聲音和畫面同步，而且不碰到字。
promptEn:
An 8-second animated slapstick clip on a soft pale lavender background, with one single Traditional Chinese glyph 蝶 as the only text on screen, drawn in saturated violet-purple solid strokes, centered, uncropped, about 70% of frame height with generous margins.

Lead: a boxy toy robot built from mismatched parts, one arm much longer than the other, with motors that always run too strong. Guard: a squeaky pull-back toy race car with googly eyes, dozing in front of a small potted plant with a straight wooden stem and three flat leaves. A shimmering lilac toy butterfly sits on the top leaf.

0-1.5s: the robot peeks in from the left edge, eyes zoom in on the butterfly, and it points with its long arm, rubbing its hands together. The car snores with tiny squeaks, googly eyes drooping shut.

1.5-3.3s: the robot tiptoes right with huge exaggerated high steps, trying to be quiet, but every step lands with a loud SQUEAK and a floor-shaking thud because its motors are too strong. The first 蝶 is spoken as its long arm stretches out for the butterfly; the butterfly hops one leaf higher, the arm overshoots and gently bonks the car's hood. Two bolts rattle off the robot and roll to the left.

3.3-5s: the car's googly eyes POP open, the two are nose to face, both scream with wide-open mouths, a frozen beat, then the car zooms nose-first and the robot scrambles backward and they CRASH into the pot with cartoon squash and stretch. The pot tips over: the wooden stem and three leaves topple and stack upright into the right-hand 枼, while the bolts and a springy coil shaken off the robot roll and curl into the left-hand 虫. The second 蝶 is spoken exactly as these strokes snap into place.

5-8s: the glyph 蝶 holds perfectly still and fully readable. 蝴蝶 is spoken as the lilac butterfly flutters up out of the little dust puff, loops once, and lands on the robot's head at the bottom-left, away from the strokes. The robot grins dizzily with a wobbly sway and the car's googly eyes spin, both clear of the glyph.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "蝶、蝶、蝴蝶" (ㄉㄧㄝˊ、ㄉㄧㄝˊ、ㄏㄨˊ ㄉㄧㄝˊ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, a short pause between the two single utterances, and stops after the word. No other speech, no subtitles, no vocabulary text, soft squeaks and bonks only, no music louder than the voice. Bright but not neon palette, nothing busy behind, no watermark, no flashing, no other writing.
